entries.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create one cinematic photographic FIRST FRAME of an original Korean absurd low-budget office comedy, 16:9 landscape 1536x864, full-bleed no black bars. This is a single moment before movement, no panels, no collage. A plain gray-green fluorescent office makeshift filming set between two square columns, floor tape marks, cheap practical props and slightly exaggerated earnest acting. Four fictional Korean adults, no real celebrity. Center P is a woman in her 30s with black hair tied low, pale green button-up shirt, dark gray chinos, white sneakers; a thin closed YELLOW notebook firmly tucked UNDER HER LEFT ARMPIT. Right B is a man in his 30s, short black hair, light gray sweatshirt, navy trousers. P and B face each other, their raised RIGHT palms separated by 10cm above head height, BEFORE the high-five. On left foreground D, woman 40s short curly bob under a red cap, black vest white T-shirt gray trousers, holds a single black-and-white blank clapperboard low at chest just before raising it. Far right background T, man 20s-30s short hair, dark teal work shirt beige trousers, holds one clear packing-tape roll with clean sleeves. Behind actors at waist height runs a 20cm wide cream paper ribbon between columns, torn at the center with both ragged ends drooping; single plain blue circle on the LEFT end. One gray folding chair behind P toward left of her path. Fixed wide composition, full bodies and feet visible, readable earnest fake-celebration pose. Avoid glossy corporate advertising, extra people, invented text, writing on clapperboard, logos, watermarks, digital rewind effects, confetti, trophies, visible stage lights. Exactly one yellow notebook. Natural anatomy.
entries.first_frame: P와 B의 오른손이 머리 위에서 서로 10cm 떨어져 있다. P의 왼쪽 겨드랑이에 노란 노트. D는 왼쪽에서 슬레이트를 들어 올리기 직전. 뒤의 넓은 종이 띠는 중앙이 찢어져 양끝이 아래로 처져 있다.
entries.next_motion: D의 지시 → 배우가 손을 이상하게 벌리고 팔을 내려 되감기 연기 시작.

artist_review.notes: 실제 저장본 열어 확인. 네 인물·노란 노트·아직 닿지 않은 하이파이브·찢긴 띠·의자 확인. T 소매 깨끗함. 제목/자막 없음.

entries.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create one photographic FIRST FRAME for an original deliberately low-budget Korean spy comedy. Full-bleed 16:9 landscape wide, no letterbox, no collage. Each actor reaches down with their INNER arm to hold the oversized cloth handle of their own CLOSED rectangular SOFT briefcase on floor in center: A's bag BLACK at center-left, B's bag DARK BROWN center-right. Each bag handle has ONE palm-sized open plastic S-hook attached, visible cheap taped join. Two S-hooks approach one another but remain separated by 5cm, NOT interlocked yet. No gun, no money, no technology, no secret markings, no text, no titles, no logo, no third person, no extra bag or hook.
